sourceTitle: A synopsis of the birds of North America
description: "A Synopsis of the Birds of North America" by John James Audubon is a scientific publication written in the early 19th century. This work serves as a systematic catalog of North American bird species, providing descriptions and classifications based on Audubon’s previous studies and observations.
